design_request_form.type: Interactive ICT Solution Estimator & Proposal Request Form
design_request_form.submission_handler: Instant validation with Sonner toast notification and interactive quote summary preview

testing_requirements.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, nav links, inputs, selects, form submit, service cards, contact links) MUST have explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-services-link', data-testid='submit-proposal-btn', data-testid='contact-phone-1').

instructions_for_main_agent: 1. Read all component guidelines and use pure React JS with Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + Lucide-react.
2. Keep the warm paper palette (#FBF9F5 base, #1B3B2B deep green, #C85A32 burnt terracotta accent) and non-generic fonts (Outfit + IBM Plex Sans).
3. Build a fully functional single-page layout or multi-tab application with smooth scroll sections (#home, #services, #projects, #team, #contact, #request-form).
4. Ensure every card and interactive component has appropriate hover state effects and data-testid attributes.
5. Include a floating interactive Design Request Form / Quote Estimator that computes estimated installation turnaround time.
6. Use Sonner toasts for form submissions and copy-to-clipboard contact actions.
7. Create custom SVG graphics for the network node logo and Starlink/CCTV technical diagrams.
